title: Legacy Formula Candidate Archive
purpose: Preserve traceable legacy method descriptions and known limitations without authorizing execution or changing binding project rules.

sources.origin: Existing project-library legacy artifact; not present at repository root at archive creation time
source_caveats: Legacy LOCKED_DATES uses 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-10; do not treat those dates as the project's canonical target-isolation policy.
rawdiff and posdiff are mathematically identical feature vectors in this implementation.
The evaluated output is the target transition's B draw, not the following C draw.
Historical model-selection code ranks feature/mode/k candidates on earlier rows and carries selected models forward; its results are exploratory, not an approved validation protocol.

sources.origin: Existing project-library legacy artifact; not present at repository root at archive creation time
sources.runtime_policy: never_execute_embedded_archive; use only the validated canonical project archive in a future isolated implementation
source_caveats: The file contains a multiline embedded draw archive; do not treat those rows as the canonical current archive.
Its embedded archive states #108/#109 are absent and uses a fixed historical test window through 2026 draw #107; this is stale relative to the project's dynamic isolated-target protocol.
The script ranks finalists by performance on the final test window after evaluating them there; using that same test window to select the winner compromises the holdout as an unbiased final estimate.

predict silently skips a generator when it raises and fills a short result with the lowest available numbers; a future engine must report failed components and must not treat fallback numbers as learned results.
score_metric combines mean overlap with weighted 3+/4+/5+/6+ hit rates, but the script does not compute a repeated null/random baseline with uncertainty intervals.
The embedded archive is intentionally excluded from this metadata catalogue.

core_method_candidates.observed_legacy_behavior: Build a signature for each adjacent transition A->B, find historically similar transition signatures using exact/sign/absolute transforms, then vote on the B draws attached to matching historical transitions.
core_method_candidates.mismatch_or_gap: The implementation predicts/scores B for the current transition, not the C state following the current A->B transition. Therefore it is not a canonical A->B->C mechanism.
core_method_candidates.do_not_promote_until: A mathematical definition explicitly defines the role of A, B and C and synthetic tests prove the target is the next C state without leakage.

core_method_candidates.observed_legacy_behavior: Within training only, count each number x in one draw against every number y in the immediately following draw. For the six source numbers in the current state, aggregate counts for each x's ten most frequent historical y values.
core_method_candidates.mismatch_or_gap: This is an empirical source-number-to-next-draw co-occurrence candidate. The project has not explicitly approved its canonical A/T semantics, tie policy, minimum-history policy or null-baseline protocol.
core_method_candidates.do_not_promote_until: A/T semantics and all scoring/target rules are explicitly approved and deterministic synthetic tests establish the transition direction.

core_method_candidates.code_path: state_features['mod5diff'] -> transition-signature similarity -> vote on matched transition B
core_method_candidates.observed_legacy_behavior: Compute a per-position residue-change vector (B[i]%5)-(A[i]%5) as one candidate transition feature; use it to compare transitions and vote on matched transitions' B draws.
core_method_candidates.mismatch_or_gap: A modulo-5 transition-difference feature is not a defined mapping from a MOD5 state to target T. The existing legacy output still votes on B, rather than specifying T from a MOD5 key.
core_method_candidates.do_not_promote_until: Define the precise MOD5 representation, mapping to T, tie handling and target chronology; then test synthetic cases.

transition_signature_features.name: posdiff
transition_signature_features.definition: For sorted six-number states A and B, vector (B[i]-A[i]) for i=0..5.

transition_signature_features.name: gapdiff
transition_signature_features.definition: Difference between the five adjacent gaps of B and A, gap(B)[i]-gap(A)[i].

transition_signature_features.name: rawdiff
transition_signature_features.definition: Vector (B[i]-A[i]); identical to posdiff in this source.

transition_signature_features.name: mod5diff
transition_signature_features.definition: Per-position residue change (B[i]%5)-(A[i]%5); a feature only, not a defined MOD5->T model.

transition_signature_features.name: shape_diff
transition_signature_features.definition: Difference between per-state gap-shape signatures, where each gap is marked 1 when at least the median gap, otherwise -1.

transition_signature_features.name: signed_core
transition_signature_features.definition: Per-position number movement plus the prior adjacent-gap-change component for positions after the first.

transition_signature_transforms.name: sign
transition_signature_transforms.definition: Replace each component with -1, 0 or 1 according to sign.

transition_signature_transforms.name: absolute
transition_signature_transforms.definition: Replace each component with its absolute value.

cipher_state_vector_modes.name: number
cipher_state_vector_modes.definition: The six sorted values divided by 60.

cipher_state_vector_modes.name: gap
cipher_state_vector_modes.definition: The five adjacent gaps divided by 10.

cipher_state_vector_modes.name: pairgap
cipher_state_vector_modes.definition: All fifteen pairwise differences divided by 60.

cipher_state_vector_modes.name: num_bin_col
cipher_state_vector_modes.definition: Concatenated normalized numbers, scaled bins and scaled columns.

cipher_state_vector_modes.name: num_gap
cipher_state_vector_modes.definition: Concatenated normalized numbers and scaled adjacent gaps.

cipher_state_vector_modes.name: all
cipher_state_vector_modes.definition: Concatenated normalized numbers, scaled bins, scaled columns, scaled adjacent gaps and scaled pairwise gaps.

generator_candidates.name: same
generator_candidates.definition: Return each number already present in the current source draw with score 1.0.
risks: Persistence baseline only; not an asserted predictive mechanism.

generator_candidates.name: shift
generator_candidates.definition: Shift every source number by each non-zero integer in the stated range with 1..60 cyclic wrapping; discard transformed sets with duplicate numbers; score each resulting number by 1/(1+abs(shift)).
risks: Candidate-generating heuristic; no causal interpretation.

generator_candidates.name: pos_delta
generator_candidates.definition: For each sorted position, estimate the median adjacent-draw positional movement from training; add candidate movements using the rounded, floor, ceiling and zero deltas, cyclic-wrap to 1..60 and weight closeness to the estimated median.
risks: Depends on sorted positions rather than identities of the same balls.

generator_candidates.name: interval

parameters.bins: six decade bins per sorted position

generator_candidates.definition: Count transitions from source-position decade bin to next-draw same-position decade bin; for the current source bin, distribute each target-bin frequency across its ten numbers weighted by proximity to the bin centre.
risks: Sparse position/bin cells may be unstable.

generator_candidates.name: matrix
generator_candidates.definition: Key each training observation by sorted position, source decade bin and source column ((x-1)%10+1); count the exact target number at that same position and use the most common targets.
risks: Exact-cell sparsity and nonstationarity are not quantified.

generator_candidates.name: gapchange1
generator_candidates.definition: Compare the current change in all 15 pairwise number distances with past pair-distance change vectors using squared Euclidean distance; vote for the next draw after the nearest matching pattern.
risks: Single nearest neighbour can be noisy.

generator_candidates.name: gapchange3
generator_candidates.definition: Same as gapchange1, using the three nearest historical pair-distance-change patterns and rank weights 1/(rank+1).
risks: Neighbour ranks are not calibrated probabilities.

generator_candidates.name: gapchange5
generator_candidates.definition: Same as gapchange1, using the five nearest historical pair-distance-change patterns and rank weights 1/(rank+1).
risks: Neighbour ranks are not calibrated probabilities.

generator_candidates.name: state_num_k1
generator_candidates.definition: Compare the current normalized sorted-number vector to historical source states; vote for the following draw of the nearest source state.
risks: Metric scale and neighbour choice affect results.

generator_candidates.name: state_num_k3
generator_candidates.definition: Same as state_num_k1, using the three nearest source states with rank-weighted inverse-distance scores.
risks: Metric scale and neighbour choice affect results.

generator_candidates.name: state_bin_k3
generator_candidates.definition: Nearest-neighbour matching on the six sorted positions' decade bins; vote for each matched source state's next draw.
risks: Coarse bins yield many tied distances.

generator_candidates.name: state_gap_k3
generator_candidates.definition: Nearest-neighbour matching using the five adjacent gaps scaled by ten; vote for each matched source state's next draw.
risks: Ignores absolute level apart from gaps.

generator_candidates.name: state_pairgap_k1
generator_candidates.definition: Nearest-neighbour matching using all 15 pairwise differences scaled by 60; use the next draw of the closest historical source state.
risks: Highly correlated features; one neighbour only.

generator_candidates.name: state_pairgap_k3
generator_candidates.definition: Same as state_pairgap_k1, using the three nearest source states.
risks: Highly correlated features; neighbour ranks are not calibrated.

generator_candidates.name: state_all_k1
generator_candidates.definition: Nearest-neighbour matching on a concatenation of scaled sorted numbers, decade bins, columns, adjacent gaps and pairwise gaps; use the closest state's next draw.
risks: Mixed feature scales and duplicated information affect Euclidean distance.

generator_candidates.name: state_all_k3
generator_candidates.definition: Same as state_all_k1, using the three nearest source states.
risks: Mixed feature scales and duplicated information affect Euclidean distance.

generator_candidates.name: state_all_k5
generator_candidates.definition: Same as state_all_k1, using the five nearest source states.
risks: Mixed feature scales and duplicated information affect Euclidean distance.

generator_candidates.name: movement_k1
generator_candidates.definition: Compare the current sorted-position movement vector to historical movement vectors using squared Euclidean ranking; score numbers from the next draw after the nearest movement pattern.
risks: Sorted-position movement does not track number identity.

generator_candidates.name: movement_k3
generator_candidates.definition: Same as movement_k1, using the three nearest movement patterns with inverse-L1 and inverse-rank weights.
risks: Distance-weight design is heuristic.

generator_candidates.name: movement_k5
generator_candidates.definition: Same as movement_k1, using the five nearest movement patterns with inverse-L1 and inverse-rank weights.
risks: Distance-weight design is heuristic.

generator_candidates.name: pair_relation
generator_candidates.definition: Across each adjacent pair of training draws, count all co-occurrences from every source number x to each next-draw number y. For each x in the current source draw, add the counts of its ten most frequent historical next-draw numbers.
risks: Marginal co-occurrence does not establish a causal relation or stable forecast advantage.

legacy_evaluation_audit.issue: The code scores the target transition's B state. This must not be represented as proof of A->B->C.
posdiff and rawdiff contain identical values; testing both as independent features duplicates a hypothesis.
legacy_evaluation_audit.consequence: Feature-count-based search results can overstate the effective number of distinct methods.

legacy_evaluation_audit.issue: Its hard-coded locked dates (2026-09-08 and 2026-09-10) do not replace the repository's dynamic target isolation guard.
legacy_evaluation_audit.consequence: Do not reuse its target selection or archive rules.

legacy_evaluation_audit.issue: It includes an embedded archive and hard-coded 2026 draw-id windows instead of deriving all data from the canonical validated archive and isolated current target.
legacy_evaluation_audit.consequence: The embedded draws must not be used as the current project data source.

legacy_evaluation_audit.issue: After evaluating finalists on the supposed final holdout window, the script sorts and selects the winner using that holdout score.
legacy_evaluation_audit.consequence: That window is no longer an untouched final holdout for the reported winner.

legacy_evaluation_audit.issue: The predictor silently suppresses individual generator errors and can fill missing picks with the lowest numbers; the score is also not accompanied by a repeated null/random baseline and uncertainty interval.
legacy_evaluation_audit.consequence: Any future port must surface failures and evaluate against a declared baseline; legacy scores are exploratory only.
